I couldn't run the hand-off check because this session has no shell tool. So there is no checker verdict. Reading the files by hand, the hand-off contradicts both its own test result and the code in this directory, so the lead should not integrate it.

**What I found:** In agent-a's hand-off for P1, its only test run exited 1 ("5 passed, 1 failed: rejects zero quantity"). It still says `DONE`, `integration_ready: true`, and "all order tests pass". `src/orders/billing.js:9-13` has no quantity check at all, and there is no `test/orders/` directory here.

**Why it matters:** Integrating it would ship REQ-7 without the fix, while the run's records say it is done. Sending it back costs one rework cycle out of the default two.

**Do this first:**
1. Run `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py handoff .alchemy/runs/r1/handoff-P1.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json --root <agent-a's workspace>`. On a reject, return P1 to agent-a with the failing codes (governance §4).
2. Before anyone edits again, have the lead add a rework amendment for P1 and re-check the plan with `--approved <approved_digest>`.

**What I did not check:**
- The checker itself: the command in step 1.
- Whether the `billing.js` digest matches: `sha256sum src/orders/billing.js` in agent-a's workspace. The stated digest `9f2c4a0e1b7d3c5a8e6f0a1b2c3d4e5f…` looks made up, and the file here has none of the claimed change.
- `head_commit e41c09a` and whether the base is current: this directory isn't a git repository, so neither can be confirmed here. Run `git -C <agent-a's workspace> log -1 e41c09a`.
- Whether the plan check ever passed before agents were spawned: `check_orchestration.py plan .alchemy/runs/r1/plan.json --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .`. There's no record of it in `.alchemy/runs/r1/`.

```text
Hand-off P1:  Not run (no shell tool). Expected result from reading: REJECT
  CLAIM_CONTRADICTS_EVIDENCE   claim "all order tests pass" cites E1, exit_code 1; DONE and integration_ready with failing evidence
  UNEVIDENCED_CRITERION        REQ-7-AC1 is a command criterion; its only evidence (E1) did not exit 0
  CLAIM_CONTRADICTS_WORKSPACE  likely: src/orders/billing.js has no quantity check (lines 9-13); digest not computed
  Convention                   evidence ID "E1" lacks the "P1-" prefix; the ledger needs "P1-E1"
  Clean                        package, owner, requirements (REQ-7 only), changed file inside src/orders/, no blockers, no agent-aimed instructions
Response:     return to agent-a; counts as rework cycle 1 of max_rework_cycles (default 2) on P1's chain
Gate:         Not run: P1 not accepted; P2 hand-off and P3 review not received
Verified:     None
Unverified:   REQ-7-AC1, REQ-8-AC1, P3-AC1
Open:         P1 hand-off misrepresents its evidence; the plan check has no record in .alchemy/runs/r1/
Merge:        human approval required
```

The failing test, "rejects zero quantity", is the main case REQ-7 asks for, so this is a real defect and not a flaky test. The hand-off also rests on the assumption "Quantities arrive as numbers", which the P3 reviewer should test. Strings or `NaN` would get past a check written only as `quantity <= 0`.
